cases.question: German AX-17 guidance before latest revision?
cases.answer:
Part 1
Historical view: documents in effect on 2026-09-14.

The superseded German AX-17 guidance (DE-AX17-LBL-038), in effect from 2025-02-03 to 2026-09-15, specifies historical starting doses as follows: normal renal category 50 mg OD, mild renal category 50 mg OD, moderate renal category 50 mg OD, and severe renal category not recommended [E1].

Sources
[E1] DE-AX17-LBL-038 · DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8 · SUPERSEDED · effective 2025-02-03 · p.6, Historical renal dosing
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Superseded_Label_v3.8.pdf#page=6

Current version: DE-AX17-LBL-042 (DE AX17 Current Label v4.2), in effect since 2026-09-15. Ask for the current guidance to see it.

Part 2
The current German guidance for AX-17 requires baseline hepatic laboratory values with repeat testing between Day 14 and Day 21 [E1]. Hepatic monitoring thresholds are medical review for ALT/AST >3x ULN, urgent review for bilirubin >2x ULN, and repeat test for mild isolated change below trigger [E2]. Renal dose modifications are: for Normal (eGFR >=90), starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, routine monitoring [E4]; for Mild (eGFR 60-89), starting dose 50 mg OD, maximum 100 mg/day, routine monitoring [E4]; for Moderate (eGFR 30-59), starting dose 25 mg OD, maximum 50 mg/day, recheck 2-4 weeks monitoring [E4], with the moderate renal impairment starting dose also stated as 25 mg once daily [E1, E3]; for Severe (eGFR 15-29), starting dose specialist review, maximum 25 mg/day, enhanced monitoring [E4].

Sources
[E1] SB-AX17-2026-09 · SB AX17 2026 09 Safety Bulletin v1.0 · APPROVED · effective 2026-10-07 · section: HelixNova Safety Bulletin SB-AX17-2026-09
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/SB_AX17_2026_09_Safety_Bulletin.docx
[E2] SB-AX17-2026-09 · SB AX17 2026 09 Safety Bulletin v1.0 · APPROVED · effective 2026-10-07 · section: HelixNova Safety Bulletin SB-AX17-2026-09 › 4. Safety Evidence and Operational Guidance, Signal / Threshold / Action / Authority
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/SB_AX17_2026_09_Safety_Bulletin.docx
[E3] DE-AX17-LBL-042 · DE AX17 Current Label v4.2 · APPROVED · effective 2026-09-15 · p.1
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Current_Label_v4.2.pdf#page=1
[E4] DE-AX17-LBL-042 · DE AX17 Current Label v4.2 · APPROVED · effective 2026-09-15 · p.6, Table 3
     https://storage.cloud.google.com/tredence-fde-1-medevidence-vks/raw/DE_AX17_Current_Label_v4.2.pdf#page=6

Earlier version: DE-AX17-LBL-038 (DE AX17 Superseded Label v3.8), superseded on 2026-09-15. Ask for the historical guidance to see it.

cases.question: What is the current renal starting dose of AX-17?
cases.answer:
For moderate renal impairment, the US recommendation is 25 mg QD; reassess [E1] (verify against the original). For severe renal impairment, specialist assessment is indicated [E1] (verify against the original). For dialysis, there is insufficient evidence [E1] (verify against the original).

Sources
[E1] US-AX17-PI-050 · US AX17 Prescribing Information v5.0 · APPROVED · effective 2026-08-01 · p.6, US renal recommendations · VERIFY: parser text differs from the PDF
